entities.text: Shatrunjai Pundir vs State Of Uttarakhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In Criminal Appeal No.694/2026, the parties entered into a compromise and moved an application under Article-142 of the Constitution of India for recording the settlement and passing appropriate orders in terms thereof.

2. However, when the application under Article-142 of the Constitution of India was taken up, the settlement was recorded but there was no express order concerning quashing of some of the cases,
including FIR No. 106 of 2022 giving rise to Criminal Case No. 7459/2022 pending before 6th Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, Uttarakhand.
3. Learned counsel appearing for respondent no.2 has no objection to the grant of prayer made in this Miscellaneous Application.

4. Accordingly, this Miscellaneous Application is disposed of and it is directed that order dated 30.01.2026 passed in Criminal Appeal No. 694/2026, shall also be read to have quashed/closed the below mentioned cases in view of the settlement between the parties;
a. Criminal Case No.7459/2022 pending before the 6th Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Dehradun arising out of FIR No. 106 of 2022 dated 28.02.2022 registered at Police Station Raipur,
District Dehradun under Sections 498A, 323 and 504 IPC read with Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
b. Misc. Crl. Case No. 1879/2021 pending before the 9-I Addl. Civil Judge, Dehradun filed under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
c. Maintenance Case No.34/2023 pending before the Additional Family Court at Dehradun in terms of the settlement.
5. Application (IA No. 68106/2026) stands allowed in the afore-stated terms.
(NISHA KHULBEY) (CHETNA BALOONI) COURT MASTER(SH) COURT MASTER(NSH)
